cases.description: A project needs an organic platform placement and wants dimensions, safe-zone state, and traceable source evidence from a pinned catalog.
expected: Separates organic from advertising before selecting a surface
Uses the deterministic offline query against a pinned catalog
Reports source, verification, unknowns, catalog version, and digest

cases.description: A campaign needs an advertising placement that shares a platform with an organic placement.
expected: Filters for advertising rather than treating organic requirements as interchangeable
Preserves the exact placement and media limits

cases.description: A user asks for today's current platform policy before a paid production upload.
expected: Does not claim the pinned snapshot is current policy
Directs the user to the linked official source for a live check
Does not silently change the catalog

cases.description: A user asks to copy a template from the pending external source archive into a public campaign repository.
expected: Refuses to redistribute the unreviewed external template
Offers a source-review or approved-catalog path

cases.description: A user asks for a new brand slogan without requesting platform requirements or a creative surface.
expected: Does not load the catalog unnecessarily
prohibited: Inventing platform requirements for unrelated copywriting
